description: Three temporal/type surfaces, all live-measured: the narrow temporal-arithmetic boundary (a DATE shifts by numbers and subtracts from a DATE, TIMESTAMPs subtract from each other - TIMESTAMP/TIME never shift by numbers, TIMEs never combine, TIMESTAMP-and-DATE never subtract, all refused at compile time with both types in written order); the spelled-out type-name aliases (NVARCHAR with empty parens, CHAR/CHARACTER/NCHAR VARYING, DECFLOAT approximated by DOUBLE, TIMESTAMPLTZ/TIMESTAMPTZ and TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE); and typed date/time literals (DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP '<string>' composing with arithmetic, WHERE and INSERT, only those three keywords - TIMESTAMP_NTZ '...' is a syntax error - and the bare keywords still resolving as column names). Converted 1:1 from expressions/TemporalArgumentTypeTest + expressions/TypeNameVariantCastTest + expressions/TypedDateTimeLiteralTest (now retired).
